title: Molecular Characterization of Meningioma
needs_manual_review_reason: No linked publication in the GEO record yet -- likely a recent/in-progress study from the Fan Lab (computational spatial transcriptomics). Full-transcriptome Visium on 19 low-grade (WHO I/II) meningiomas, cross-classified by bulk methylation into the Merlin-intact/immune-enriched/hypermitotic groups from Choudhury et al. 2022 -- worth checking in a future session whether the underlying methylation data was also deposited separately. FACT-CHECK UPDATE (2026-07-10 verification pass): date_deposited/date_updated filled in from the live GEO record's Series_submission_date/Series_last_update_date, previously 'Not reported'.

gene_expression_viewer.sample_label: All 19 samples, each spot plotted at its true tissue position, side by side
gene_expression_viewer.embedding_method: scanpy 1.10.3: read_10x_mtx of each sample's deposited 10x Visium output (per-sample tar.gz archives, GSM9031082-GSM9031100, filenames 'ProcessedN' where N is not contiguous -- confirmed via live per-GSM title inspection after an initial contiguous-numbering assumption produced 404s), joined against each sample's own tissue_positions.csv, kept in_tissue==1 spots only, QC (min 100 genes/spot), anndata.concat with each sample's array_col offset so all 19 tissue sections render side by side. Plotted coordinates are the TRUE physical Visium hex-grid position (array_row/array_col), not a UMAP. Clustering (Leiden, resolution 0.5, 23 clusters) uses transcriptional similarity via PCA/neighbors, same as scRNA-seq.
gene_expression_viewer.integration_note: Spots are plotted at true tissue position per sample, not merged into one shared coordinate space -- the 19 samples are independent tissue sections side by side, not directly overlaid.
